subject: an incomplete coral frame enclosing a pale stone courtyard
art_direction: 不完整珊瑚框体围住浅石庭，蓝色影阶和空白天光构成极简建筑构图。
visible_description: 不完整珊瑚框体围住浅石庭，蓝色影阶和空白天光构成极简建筑构图。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create an incomplete coral frame enclosing a pale stone courtyard. The frame is thick and architectural, with one top corner missing rather than forming a border. A short blue stair sits in the lower courtyard and catches a narrow warm highlight. Keep the upper fifth naturally open through the frame. Use flat color planes and precise shadows, with no text or objects. Use graphic architectural color blocking. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
